title: Legendary Allays
description: Adds more colors of allays, similar to the yellow allay in Minecraft Legends. Project has been archived because it does not need to be updated, unless Optifine recieves a large update.
body:
# Legendary Allays

This resource pack adds more color to your world by adding 5 new allay variants. This way, you can see which of your flying freinds are which!

**NEEDS ETF OR OPTIFINE TO WORK**
